name: staff-workspace-runtime-audit
title: Fix staff post-create crash and audit workforce pages
description: Normalize staff mutation responses before rendering and audit manager/staff attendance, leave, schedule, performance, and report flows across UI, GraphQL, resolver, scope, and tests.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Completed runtime and contract audit across manager dashboard, attendance, leave, schedule, performance, reports, plus staff self-service attendance/schedule/leave. Fixed the post-create React crash by normalizing the raw StaffPrivateProfile before selection; corrected restaurant scope propagation for attendance deep-links, embedded schedules, reports, and staff leave submission; aligned report and attendance-correction GraphQL inputs; and made leave email delivery non-transactional after a saved decision. Performance and staff self-service schedule/attendance contracts were traced and no additional confirmed defect was found. Added focused regression tests. Files were re-fetched from main for static verification; automated suites were not executed because the connector workspace has no runnable repository checkout.
